name: How Might We (HMW)
deliverable: Standardized opportunity statements ready for divergence

steps.text: Explain How, Might, We: a path exists, failure is permitted, ownership is shared; ban solutions.
Post the validated pain points, then each person drafts two to four ten-word questions per point.
Cluster identical intents without speaking, moving other people's notes that belong together.

failure: Questions come out so broad they give no grip, or so narrow they hide a chosen feature inside the question.
intervention: Ask what the user is deciding at that moment, then rewrite around that decision with one concrete constraint.
provenance: Source protocol: the steps follow the written script in the source.

origin.note: Widely used in design thinking practice; no single documented originator.
